research.facts:
AUSL Series 4 — Kilfoyl Crowned 2026 Champion
**Key Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Lexi Kilfoyl was crowned the 2026 AUSL All-Star Cup individual champion after the Series 4 finale on August 30
- Pre-finale standings: Klingler 890 pts (1st), Kilfoyl 866 pts (2nd) — 24-point deficit for Kilfoyl
- Team Kilfoyl defeated Team Klingler 4-3 in the Series 4 final game; Sami Williams was clutch late
- Kilfoyl earned 3 Game MVPs during the All-Star Cup — the most of any player in the league
- Klingler went 4-0 as captain across the All-Star Cup's regular series
- The series ran Aug 8-30, 2026 at Parkway Bank Sports Complex, Rosemont, Illinois
- Hannah Flippen was eliminated after Series 4 Game 2 (Team Kilfoyl def. Flippen 4-1 on Aug 29; Willis 5 IP, 1R)
**Source:** theausl.com, mlb.com/news, first search result summary

**Key Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- WBSC Women's Softball World Cup Group Stage: Sept. 12-16 at Devon Park, Oklahoma City
- Head coach: Patty Gasso (with JT Gasso and Jennifer Rocha on staff)
- Roster: 16 players; 7 from 2025 World Games gold medal squad; 10 from Down Under Series
- 2020 Olympians on roster: Valerie Garcia and Aubree Mulipola
- USA opens vs. No. 7 Mexico on September 12
- Netherlands ranked No. 6 — key top-seed decider matchup
- Top 2 from Group Oklahoma advance to Redcliffe, QLD, Australia Finals (April 5-11, 2027)
- Highest finisher at Finals earns LA28 Olympic qualification berth
**Source:** usasoftball.com, wbsc.org, soonersports.com
